Memorandum To The File:

February 14, 1984

Lorillard

MEMORANDUM

Hugh Cullman and Jim Bowling called at 9:40 AM in reply to my dexed letter of yesterday which requested suggestions for my comments at the NTC Meeting in Phoenix.

They, very courteously, suggested two topics:

1. Cigarettes and Health

2. Cigarettes and Taxation

-- both focusing on the ultimate fact that we have to sell cigarettes in order to need and use tobacco, etc., etc.

We briefly discussed editorial reaction to the RJR campaign and nothing else.

CHJ:cg

[SIGNATURE] Esq.

Original to: A. J. Stevens, Esq.

03550080
